description: Free, read-only. Fetch a public http(s) URL and return its <head> metadata as JSON: url (after redirects), title, description, canonical, robots, author, keywords, lang, charset, og{} and twitter{} (prefix stripped), httpEquiv{}, jsonLd[] (parsed blocks, malformed ones skipped). Absent fields are null or {}. Reads only the first 512 KB, follows up to 5 redirects, 10 s timeout; private and local hosts are rejected and non-2xx responses error with the HTTP status. Runs no JavaScript, so tags injected client-side are not seen. Not for body text: use fetch_extract (plain text) or fetch_html (raw HTML).

headers.description: Headers to forward for pages behind login: Authorization, Cookie, X-API-Key only. Dropped if a redirect leaves the original host.

url.description: Public http:// or https:// URL. Local and private hosts are rejected.

name: fetch_metadata
title: Fetch page metadata
